extras: Must not be enabled alongside Better MD Diff; both register the same view type (better-md-diff-view). Desktop only, and the vault folder must be the Git repository root. Free, no account, and no network use.
intentEvidence: Uncommitted is a fork of kamacheng/better-md-diff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see which vault files changed since the last Git commit or review those changes before committing.

relations.evidence: Uncommitted is a fork of kamacheng/better-md-diff.

summary: Git status viewer that lists every vault file differing from the last commit with status letters and a diff for review.
